name: Product analyst
summary: Shows where users drop off, how long customers stay and which groups come back. Plans the tracking and tests to fix the biggest leak.

changelog.note: First release: 30 sources (GA4, Amplitude, Mixpanel, PostHog and Segment docs, Evan Miller, Microsoft ExP, GOV.UK trial, GDPR, CNIL, FTC). Four skills (tracking plan, funnel, retention cohorts, test plan), five prompts, two workflows, training. Deleting data or events needs a fresh yes.

Named the UK regulator as the Information Commission, which replaced the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) on 30 Sep 2026 and still uses the ICO name. Linked the regulator's storage and access and data minimisation guidance.
